data.content_ref: inline:The asserted reduction is backwards, so the relation fails the problem's demand for a SUBSTANTIVE, correctly-typed connection. A reduction ('X reduces to Y') requires that X's outcome is explained by, or collapses into, Y's mechanism. Here SRC_001 claims the 3-of-26 result 'reduces to an under-powered measurement artifact,' but it provides no mechanism showing how low statistical power generates the 3-of-26 survival ratio; the only test offered is that a larger multi-author repository 'reproducing the same shown-to-fail ritual still yields a 3-of-26 survival ratio' — which demonstrates persistence of the ratio, not its reduction to a measurement confound. Worse, the refutation condition is self-defeating: if the larger repository reproduces the same ratio while eliminating the power artifact, that would refute the reduction claim, yet SRC_001 treats it as the refutation of the whole relation. The 'refuted if' clause therefore does not specify a condition that would falsify the posited relation between 007dca563e8d and its neighbourhood; it merely restates the observation that motivated the reduction, leaving the relation unsubstantiated.
